jobs.title: Consultant Town Planner
jobs.description:
Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Start here. Grown Here.

We have an opportunity for a Consultant Town Planner.
AECOM’s Planning and Stakeholder Engagement business is recruiting Consultant Planners to help deliver our existing portfolio of projects and a pipeline of projects, across a range of sectors, principally delivering large scale infrastructure.

As our Town Planning team is national, and we support hybrid working we are flexible in terms of base location. The role can be based from our offices in Basingstoke, and London Aldgate,
with an option for hybrid working.

Here’s what you’ll do:

You will be joining a market leading, experienced infrastructure planning team and will, be given the following responsibilities.

Planning & Development Management

Assist in the management and successful delivery of major development applications.
Provide planning advice to colleagues and clients, including the application of permitted development rights.
Carry out planning research and analysis and assist with the identification of planning risks.

Technical Reporting & Documentation

Prepare Planning Statements and Design and Access Statements to support development applications.
Liaise with the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) team to ensure coordinated project delivery.

Project Coordination & Delivery

Help coordinate multi-disciplinary teams across a variety of project types.
Assist with project management activities to support successful project outcomes.
Implement quality assurance and health and safety principles.

Business Development & Commercial Support

Contribute to the preparation of successful commercial tenders.

Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

Participate in internal and external meetings.
Build effective working relationships with colleagues, clients, and project stakeholders.

Does this sound like something you can do, and do well? If so, read on…

MORE ABOUT THE WORK
- We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it’s improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive.

We have an impressive portfolio of involvement in major infrastructure projects, including delivery of projects through various consenting regimes including Development Consent Orders. We are currently leading on consenting applications for renewables and wider energy/electricity related infrastructure, transport, defence, water and much more.

You will be able to work on a range of prestigious infrastructure projects for our clients in the energy transition, rail and water development sectors, as well as regional and local developments. AECOM is a market leader in UK infrastructure development, with experience of over 80 Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects. Join us now and you could be working on:

numerous solar DCOs with a pipeline of future work;
carbon capture and energy storage projects;
energy transmission schemes including for National Grid’s Great Grid Upgrade;
large aviation and rail projects; and
housing and mixed-use development consenting.

PLANNING AT AECOM
- AECOM is a top ten UK Planning consultancy by size, employing around 70 Chartered or Licentiate Planners, practicing in all areas of the discipline. AECOM is also a worldwide leader in environmental and engineering consultancy and working as a planning consultant within AECOM means access to some of the highest profile and prestigious development projects in the UK, working with colleagues operating at the cutting edge of their disciplines as part of the largest UK environmental consultancy.

You will be joining a great team; you will have an interesting and diverse workload and you will be given the opportunity to make the most of your abilities.

What's not to like? Come and join us and we'll grow together.

Qualifications

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Professional Qualifications

Licentiate Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) or an equivalent professional town planning organisation and working towards full accreditation.

Planning & Technical Expertise

Demonstrable experience of working on major planning applications.
Sound knowledge of UK planning policy and legislation.
Experience of working on Development Consent Order (DCO) and/or Transport and Works Act Order (TWAO) applications.
Understanding of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) legislation.
Experience identifying, evaluating, and managing planning risk.

Commercial & Consultancy Skills

Commercial awareness and the ability to write clearly and concisely.
Consultancy experience, including monitoring and managing project budgets and programmes.

Stakeholder & Team Collaboration

Client-focused with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative working approach, demonstrating a high level of commitment to quality.
Experience working in collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams.

Project Delivery & Technical Competencies

Ability to work effectively to tight deadlines.
Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.

Additional Information

Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

For further information about the role, reach out to the recruiter on LinkedIn Anne Marie Flynn | LinkedIn

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. jobs.title: Senior Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Salary:
£60,000 to £70,000 base + 10% bonus and comprehensive benefits
Location:
Old Street 2 days per week, 3 days from home.

Why this role?

Take ownership of complex customer projects for large organisations in the UK and internationally.
Join a successful, growing B2B technology business where your work has real visibility and impact.
Combine project leadership, customer consulting and problem-solving in a role with plenty of autonomy.
Work closely with senior customer stakeholders from initial handover through to successful launch.

About our client

Our client is an established B2B fintech providing software to large organisations around the world.

Following continued growth, they are expanding their professional services team to support an increasing number of enterprise customers.

The business has built a collaborative, high-trust culture where people are given genuine ownership of their work. It offers the pace and autonomy of a scale-up, alongside the stability of an established and successful software business.

The opportunity

As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will take ownership of customer implementation projects from the point a new client signs through to successful launch.

You’ll become the main point of contact during this process, bringing together customer teams and internal specialists to keep projects moving and ensure everything is delivered successfully.
It’s a varied role. One day you might be running a customer workshop, the next resolving an implementation challenge, managing competing priorities or helping senior stakeholders understand what needs to happen next.

You won’t need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable working with technology and discussing requirements with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What you will be doing

Manage multiple enterprise customer projects from kick-off through to launch.
Own project plans, milestones, dependencies and customer communication.
Run discovery sessions, workshops and regular project meetings.
Coordinate customer teams and internal specialists to keep projects on track.
Identify potential problems early and take ownership of resolving them.
Help customers understand requirements and translate complex information into clear next steps.
Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders throughout the implementation process.
Ensure customers have a smooth transition into using the platform successfully.
Contribute to improving delivery processes as the professional services function continues to grow.

What you will need to succeed

Experience working in SaaS professional services or implementation for a fintech company.
A track record of delivering complex projects for larger or enterprise customers.
Confidence managing several customer projects at the same time.
Comfortable working with technical teams and understanding how different software systems and data processes fit together.
Excellent communication skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders.
A practical, proactive approach to solving problems.
Comfortable working in a growing technology business where processes are still evolving.

You’ll suit this role if you enjoy taking ownership, working directly with customers and being the person responsible for getting complex projects over the line.

jobs.title: Town Planner
jobs.description:
My client is a well-established, multi-disciplinary property and design group. It brings together specialists in architecture, engineering, interior design, surveying and land sourcing under one roof, so clients get joined-up support from the first site appraisal through to completion.

Planning is central to almost everything the group delivers. It now wants to appoint a Head of Planning to lead planning across all in-house projects. Working directly with the Managing Director, you'll also help build a planning consultancy service for external clients.

This is a rare chance to own the planning function from day one. You'll shape how it works, build its reputation and grow it into a standalone revenue-generating service.

The role

Act as the in-house planning lead across a varied portfolio, including residential, barn conversions, listed buildings and heritage, commercial, mixed-use and masterplanning.
Give strategic planning advice from early feasibility and land appraisal through to submission, determination and discharge of conditions.
Prepare and manage planning applications, appeals, pre-application submissions and supporting statements.
Work closely with in-house architects, engineers and designers so planning strategy shapes design from the start.
Build strong relationships with local planning authorities, statutory consultees and other stakeholders across Kent and the South East.
Work with the MD to set up the external planning consultancy, including the service offering, fee structures, positioning and growth plans.
Lead business development and work winning, including identifying opportunities, writing fee proposals and bids, and turning leads into instructions.
Develop and look after a client base of landowners, developers, self-builders, promoters and commercial clients.
Represent the business at networking events and industry forums, and through referral partners.
As the service grows, build and lead a planning team.

About you

A chartered town planner (MRTPI), with substantial post-qualification experience.
Currently working in, or with a strong background in, private-sector planning consultancy.
Experienced in running a varied, multi-project caseload and moving between scales and project types with confidence.
A proven record of winning work and developing clients. You're comfortable generating fees, not just delivering them.
Commercially minded, with an entrepreneurial streak and the drive to build something rather than simply step into it.
Strong knowledge of national and local planning policy, with heritage and rural or Green Belt experience a real advantage.
Knowledge of the Kent and wider South East planning landscape and local authorities would be a significant plus.
A confident communicator who earns credibility quickly with clients, design teams and planning officers.

What's on offer

A salary of £60,000 to £80,000 depending on experience, plus a benefits package.
Flexible working.
A senior, high-visibility role working directly with the MD.
The chance to build and lead a new consultancy offering, with real influence over its direction and growth.
A collaborative, multi-disciplinary setting where planning sits at the heart of every project.
Long-term career progression as the planning service grows.

jobs.description:
London, England

About Clearwater Analytics

Clearwater Analytics® is a global SaaS solution for automated investment data aggregation, reconciliation, accounting, and reporting. Clearwater helps thousands of organisations make the most of investment portfolio data with cloud-native software and client-centric servicing. Every day, investment professionals worldwide trust Clearwater to deliver timely, validated investment data and in-depth reporting.

Job Description

We are looking for a Solutions Consultant to join our growing EMEA Asset Owner team in London - corporate pension schemes, local government pension funds (LGPS), sovereign wealth funds, and insurers, front to back office. In this client-facing, pre-sales role you will be central to how Clearwater wins and onboards complex asset management mandates — owning the technical and written deliverables that move opportunities through the sales cycle. 

You will partner with prospective clients to uncover the pain points in their current operating model and demonstrate, clearly and credibly, how the Clearwater solution solves those problems and adds measurable value. Alongside this you will build and refine the sales resources, documentation and standards the wider EMEA team relies on, continually looking for ways to strengthen our proposition. 

The ideal candidate is a creative, self-starting problem-solver who earns the trust of internal and external stakeholders alike, combining strong technical fluency with the commercial instinct to turn complex requirements into compelling solutions.

Responsibilities

Work with prospective clients to understand their current infrastructure, business requirements and operational challenges, and articulate how Clearwater's solution enhances their operating model. 

Lead the pre-sales workstream on complex software sales, from discovery through to solution design and handover. 
Develop deep, demonstrable expertise across Clearwater's products and the value they deliver. 
Communicate Clearwater's core value proposition persuasively, through written documentation, demonstrations and live presentations. 
Own the completion, organisation and coordination of prospect RFPs and DDQs, ensuring high-quality, accurate and timely responses. 
Conduct the research and preparation that underpins high-impact sales meetings and demos. 
Coordinate resources across Clearwater to support sales efforts and a smooth transition of new clients to our Global Delivery team. 
Solve complex, abstract problems and develop creative solutions to non-standard client requirements. 

Required Skills:

Proven record of exceeding goals/quotas. 
Relevant experience in Asset Management, Asset Owner, Insurance, Investment Management, FinTech, Investment Accounting, or Investment Operations. 
Commitment to agility, continuous learning, improvement, and operational excellence. 
Strong data analysis skills. 
Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.  
Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.  
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.  
Strong organizational and interpersonal skills. 
Exceptional problem-solving abilities.   

Requirements:

Relevant experience in investment operations, investment management, insurance or investment accounting. 
A clear understanding of the challenges facing the industry, particularly around reporting, data management and accounting. 
Familiarity with the needs of the different personas within an asset owner, from front office to operations, finance and technology and a proficient understanding of the Asset Owner market in UK and Europe.
Good knowledge of financial services and fixed income securities; a professional qualification such as the CFA is preferable. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and articulate complex propositions clearly. 
Strong organisational, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. 
Strong technical skills, including Excel and the ability to quickly become proficient in in-house software solutions. 
A commitment to agility, continuous learning and operational excellence, combined with competitiveness, curiosity, creativity and drive. 
Fluent in business English, additional languages preferable

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant (EMEA & RoW)
jobs.description:
Frontify is the brand platform behind some of the world's leading organizations, including Microsoft, Telefónica, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Kia. We help every team bring brands to life — with governance in one place, seamless workflows across the tools people already use, and a foundation that's ready for AI.

We're driven by collaboration, curiosity, and the belief that great work can happen anywhere. What began in St. Gallen has grown to London, New York, and beyond. Wherever you join us, you'll take ownership from day one, shape work that reaches global brands, and help redefine how brands work in the age of AI.

What You'll Shape

You’ll be the ultimate product expert: The go-to person for detailed instructions and guidance on what is (and what isn’t) possible with Frontify. Not only do you know how to position Frontify for various use cases when helping our commercial teams during a pitch, but you’ll also find creative workarounds and alternative ways of using our platform in order to improve the value a customer gets out of Frontify, and you will add valuable insights for our product strategy based on customer interactions. To best support our commercial teams, you’ll also get to know the tools our customers use most and advise on how to use Frontify with these tools through integrations, plugins, or separately. These tools include Figma, InDesign, CMSs and n8n. You’re curious to learn how our customers use items like Frontify’s API and SDK to improve their Frontify experience, even if you haven’t worked with these before.

As the centralized repository for technical consulting, you’ll collaborate with our Sales and Customer Success teams to successfully convert opportunities and grow accounts over time. You’ll also build a bridge to Product Marketing and Product Management teams to generate scalable materials and trainings that will help the company’s commercial success.

What You'll Do

You'll become the go-to expert on Frontify, advising internal teams on platform capabilities, best practices, and creative solutions for a wide range of customer use cases.
You'll partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to deliver technical consultations, support customer evaluations, and help convert opportunities into long-term customer partnerships.
You'll position Frontify's capabilities through tailored demonstrations and solution design, finding innovative ways to maximize customer value.
You'll advise customers and internal teams on integrating Frontify with tools such as Figma, Adobe InDesign, CMS platforms, automation tools, and other technologies.
You'll deepen your expertise in Frontify's APIs, SDK, and extensibility capabilities to help customers solve complex technical challenges.
You'll capture customer feedback and technical insights to influence product strategy and help shape future platform development.
You'll collaborate with Product Marketing and Product Management to create scalable enablement content, technical documentation, and training materials for commercial teams.
You'll continuously explore new technologies, customer workflows, and industry trends to strengthen Frontify's technical consulting capabilities.
Comfortable with a hybrid work model, spending 1-2 days per week in our St. Gallen or London office.

What You Bring

You have 4+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role, ideally in SaaS.
You combine strong technical curiosity with a commercial mindset and enjoy helping customers solve complex business challenges.
You're quick to master new products and technical concepts, and you thrive on becoming the trusted expert others turn to for guidance.
You're familiar with design, automation, or collaboration tools such as Figma, Adobe InDesign, Make.com, or n8n. Experience with APIs or SDKs is a plus.
You balance strategic thinking with attention to detail, always keeping the broader business impact in mind.
You confidently guide and influence internal stakeholders, explaining complex technical concepts in a clear and approachable way.

CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.

Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.

CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.

Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.

Requirements

Position Summary:

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is the strategic quarterback for an assigned portfolio of enterprise accounts, responsible for driving customers from initial deployment to long-term value realization. Acting as a trusted partner—akin to a Client Account Manager in IT consulting—the CSM builds deep relationships across customer leadership, manages execution roadmaps, and ensures the customer achieves measurable business outcomes using the CloudBees platform.

While possessing high technical aptitude and fluency in modern DevOps, CI/CD, and agentic coding concepts, the CSM is not a hands-on technical implementer. Instead, the CSM orchestrates internal resources (Support, Professional Services, Field CTOs) to solve technical challenges while keeping their focus on platform adoption, customer health, and uncovering strategic expansion opportunities.

Note: This role will be in Hybrid in London, and the scope of the role will cover the EMEA territory.

Key Responsibilities:

Value Realization & Account Leadership (The Quarterback)
Drive Business Outcomes: Partner with key stakeholders to define technical success, build actionable adoption roadmaps, and track customer progress toward clear ROI.

Relationship Mapping: Cultivate strong relationships with Executive Sponsors and key Champions; actively identify and develop new champions across departments.
Account Governance: Maintain account success plans, monitor overall health metrics, and mobilize internal resources to resolve risks proactively.
Strategic Discovery & Expansion Pipeline
Identify Opportunities: Deeply understand customer workflows to uncover unaddressed needs, expansion pathways, and professional services opportunities.
Partner with Sales: Collaborate closely with Account Executives to flag growth potential and technical risks—handing off commercial execution, pricing, and contract negotiations to the AE.
Orchestration & Technical Acumen/Expertise
Resource Orchestration: Serve as the primary point of alignment, pulling in Professional Services for complex implementations, Support for technical troubleshooting, or Field CTOs for deep architectural guidance.
Domain Fluency: Maintain a solid, working acumen/expertise around DevOps, CI/CD, cloud technologies, and modern development practices (e.g., AI/agentic coding) to speak intelligently with engineering leaders without answering hands-on code/configuration queries.

External Constituents (The Client)

The CSM maps and nurtures relationships across all tiers of the client organization:

Executive Sponsors & Economic Buyers: VPs of Engineering, CIOs, Heads of Infrastructure/Platform—to align on business drivers, demonstrate ROI during EBRs, and secure executive sponsorship.
Internal Champions: Engineering Directors, DevOps Leads, and Platform Managers—to drive adoption roadmaps, track project execution, and advocate for platform expansion.
Operational Teams & Practitioners: Lead Architects, SRE Leads, and CI/CD Admins—to monitor usage trends, sentiment, and systemic operational blockers (while redirecting tactical execution/support queries to appropriate CB channels).

Account Executive (AE): Partner on account strategy; feed qualified expansion, service, and upsell opportunities to the AE, while maintaining a unified front on account health.

Product Management & Engineering: Voice customer enhancement requests, operational pain points, and strategic feedback to influence product roadmaps.

The CSM drives retention and account growth through strategic alignment but does not own:

Contract renewals or amendments
Commercial negotiations, pricing, or quoting
Procurement and legal execution

These activities are owned by the Account Executive.

Required

5+ years in Customer Success, Client Account Management, or Strategic Account Management in enterprise SaaS or IT consulting (e.g., Accenture, Wipro, TCS, IBM Global Services model).
Proven track record of managing enterprise accounts, conducting EBRs, and driving adoption programs.
High Technical Aptitude: Ability to converse fluently with Engineering Leaders, DevOps Managers, and Enterprise Architects on software delivery challenges without being a hands-on developer.
Project Management: Strong project management, strategic thinking, and executive presentation skills.
Organizational Change Management: Driving bottom-up developer adoption strategies to help enterprise teams overcome workflow inertia.

Preferred

Understanding of modern SDLC, DevOps culture, CI/CD, and enterprise cloud deployments.
Experience working alongside Professional Services and Technical Support teams to deliver complex customer outcomes.

Time-to-Value & Onboarding Completion
Gross & Net Retention Support (via technical adoption and account health)
Expansion Pipeline Created (leads handed off to Sales/PS)
Customer Health Score & CSAT
Execution of Account Success Plans & EBRs

Be part of opening a brand-new office. Real ownership from day one, and the chance to shape how the space works.
Broad exposure across facilities, events, HR, and marketing. A genuine launchpad for your career.
A global, collaborative team that lives by our values: Better Together, Entrepreneurs at Heart, Exceed Expectations, Serve with Passion.
Support for your headspace — literally. A company-sponsored Headspace account and a fully funded global Employee Assistance Programme, so support is there when you need it.

Upside when we win. Share in our success with a performance-based bonus plan aligned with both your personal achievements and company milestones.
People who sweat the craft. A team that takes its work seriously and invests in each other's growth.
28 vacation days, plus public holidays and floating days, giving you a minimum of 38 paid days off per year. If your country has fewer than 10 public holidays annually, we'll top up the difference with floating days.

Equity options, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success and growth.
Recognition and rewards programmes, where you can earn points and redeem them for rewards and company swag.

You will develop and maintain close relationships with management, product adoption sponsors, and/or key stakeholders throughout the customer lifecycle. What You’ll Do

Drive customer adoption of Workiva solutions
Ensure continuous ROI to your customers
Consult on best practices, workflows, and management business reviews
Develop multi-purpose relationships throughout customer organizations
Identify risks within named accounts & take appropriate actions to manage and/or escalate to an efficient resolution
Ensure all customers are continuously working toward key milestones of the Customer Journey using customer-facing Success Plans
Advocate for customers internally by providing continuous feedback to Workiva’s Sales, Services, Marketing, Product, & Engineering teams
Work with Sales to understand the details of upcoming renewals
Teach customers how to use the Workiva Platform
Use customer management tools to track customer communication, issues, and metrics

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of experience and education in a related field; an advanced degree may be considered in lieu of professional experience
2 years of related experience (Customer Success, Customer Service, Account Management or Sales)

Experience supporting a SaaS application preferred
Deep commitment to customer success - not just satisfaction
Ability to understand complex problems and explain the source of those problems simply
Strong communication and presentation skills with a high level of comfort in delivering consultative recommendations
Self-starter with strong time management and prioritization skills

Willingness to travel up to 10% for team and corporate meetings, fostering relationships and representing company interests
Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, as we embrace flexible work arrangements

Serves as the primary post-sale point of contact for clients/customers. Uses in-depth knowledge of client industry and/or business processes, deep knowledge of the product being sold and technical expertise to drive and increase adoption and utilization of company products. May recommend specific solutions to achieve customer’s desired result. Holds direct responsibility for identifying opportunities and closing additional revenue from assigned clients, including upselling and cross-selling of related products; accountable for client renewal and retention results. Ensures best practices are adopted for product use. May handle escalations and coordinate across functional areas of the company, including Marketing, Sales, Professional Services, Engineering, Finance, Training, and/or Support. May or may not be on a sales incentive plan that is based on individual and/or team sales results (e.g., revenue, bookings, unit sales). This is an individual contributor role.

Scope

Contributes to small team by taking ownership to deliver assigned activities

Problem Solving

Works on minimally ambiguous problems where solutions are often readily available
Situations typically require an evaluative review of a variety of factors to understand problems
Applies company policies, business understanding and acquired techniques to complete day-to-day assignments

Discretion and Impact

Minimally impacts quality of own work and the work of others on team
Exercises judgment, within defined procedures; sometimes adapts practices in order to apply appropriate action

May interact with high-level individual contributors and managers across multiple areas
Builds productive internal working relationships that require regular interaction across similar areas

Autonomy

Based on clearly defined objectives, receives general instructions on routine work, detailed guidance on new assignments; begins to independently prioritize work
May provide broad guidance to individuals in process-oriented roles

Knowledge

Working knowledge and practical understanding of fundamental Workiva technical standards and methods
Applying professional principles, techniques, and procedures in own area of discipline; begins to take ownership of assigned activities
Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

Job Description

This role is to support growth and customer retention across DACH region and will be responsible for a portfolio of our strategic enterprise customers. The primary objective of the role is to help guide Customers along their DEX journey, following Nexthink’s DEX Methodology, to drive growth and adoption throughout the entire customer lifecycle.

Key pillars to the Customer Success Team are: (i) Customer Success Plan, (ii) Value Tracking and (ii) Executive Business Reviews.

You will be expected to lead the customer to success in their DEX Journey. This means providing support and best practices on getting started with DEXOps, developing a plan for adoption of DEX into the Customer’s ecosystem, and ensuring positive outcomes for your customers while solidifying their long-term partnership with Nexthink.

This is a key position within the Technical Services team and the successful candidate will be expected to work collaboratively with Sales, Solution Consulting, Professional Services, Customer Support and Product teams to drive positive customer outcomes, operational success, renewals and upsell opportunities.

Main functions:

Aligned to up to 20 Nexthink Enterprise customers, you will own and execute a comprehensive customer success plan that emphasizes the critical pillars of people, processes, technology, communication and value, all aimed at effectively integrating Nexthink solutions and building a DEX journey.
Be a Trusted Advisor to the Customer: Build relationships with key leadership contacts within the CIO organization and other influential stakeholders. Have a POV on the customer industry, competitive landscape, and the DEX market. Understand the customer’s technical challenges and dependencies.
Deliver Value for the Customer: Identify, define, track, measure and share the overall impact and value of Nexthink. Guide the Customer on their journey and hold them accountable. Evangelize the customer’s success (internally, and with Customer stakeholders).
Deliver on-time Renewals & Achieve Renewal Targets: Align on account strategy with the broader account team and work to help deliver an on-time renewal (through extensive value-tracking activities and other CSM efforts)
Achieve Expansion Targets: Identify new opportunities for Nexthink, either through Professional Services engagements, or upsell/cross-sell of additional Nexthink services and solutions. Align with the Account Team on expansion strategies and upsells to deliver results.
Maintain Customer Health: Have regular cadence with the right Customer contacts and understand current sentiment and issues. Identify and escalate any critical issue or risk of renewals, collaborating with the Account Team including Account Managers, Solution Consultants, Professional Services and Support Teams.
Deliver DEX workshops to the customer that support educating and development of the customer journey in the use of the product and how to quantify the value of outcomes.
In partnership with the Account manager, participate in quarterly business reviews (Executive Business Reviews) with key customer stakeholders to communicate progress against the success plan and provide thought leadership on the customer journey focused on required outcomes.
Act as the voice of the customer and provide feedback to Nexthink Product Management, R&D, Sales and Marketing teams.
Foster collaboration within the Nexthink ecosystem (internal and external) and share best practices to enhance the customer experience and business outcomes.
Update our CRM database and make sure that customer data is always accurate and reliable.

Qualifications

7+ years of experience as a Customer Success Manager working in the Software Industry with Large Enterprise Accounts and successful adoption of SaaS.
Ability to drive the DEX Methodology (people, process, technology, communication, value) to ensure adoption and value realization.
Strong business acumen with the ability to use business context to generate creative, pragmatic solutions to achieve business objectives.
Entrepreneurial mindset that enables you to successfully work independently with little guidance; using good judgment to escalate issues when needed.
Technical background or technological savvy to be able to learn Nexthink products and services, technologies and business. (Understanding of the IT project delivery lifecycle and digital transformation initiatives is preferred.)
Ability to effectively manage, guide, and build rapport within all parts of the customer’s hierarchy, from the technical teams to the C-suite. Building relationships with our customers is key.
Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills; capable of gaining the respect of and interacting comfortably with senior leaders.
Organized and structured, with the ability to facilitate difficult/complex situations.
Have a “can do” attitude to own and drive results.
Strong understanding of IT Operations, ITSM processes (ITIL), or End User Compute/Client Management practices is preferred.
Strong customer-facing and presentation skills.
Business-level fluency in English and German is required for customer-facing communication and collaboration.
This role might require occasional travelling within the DACH region.

Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package

CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.

Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.

CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.

Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.

Requirements

Position Summary:

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is the strategic quarterback for an assigned portfolio of enterprise accounts, responsible for driving customers from initial deployment to long-term value realization. Acting as a trusted partner—akin to a Client Account Manager in IT consulting—the CSM builds deep relationships across customer leadership, manages execution roadmaps, and ensures the customer achieves measurable business outcomes using the CloudBees platform.

While possessing high technical aptitude and fluency in modern DevOps, CI/CD, and agentic coding concepts, the CSM is not a hands-on technical implementer. Instead, the CSM orchestrates internal resources (Support, Professional Services, Field CTOs) to solve technical challenges while keeping their focus on platform adoption, customer health, and uncovering strategic expansion opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

Value Realization & Account Leadership (The Quarterback)
Drive Business Outcomes: Partner with key stakeholders to define technical success, build actionable adoption roadmaps, and track customer progress toward clear ROI.
Executive Engagement: Lead Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) and operational syncs to align CloudBees capabilities with customer business priorities.
Relationship Mapping: Cultivate strong relationships with Executive Sponsors and key Champions; actively identify and develop new champions across departments.
Account Governance: Maintain account success plans, monitor overall health metrics, and mobilize internal resources to resolve risks proactively.
Strategic Discovery & Expansion Pipeline
Identify Opportunities: Deeply understand customer workflows to uncover unaddressed needs, expansion pathways, and professional services opportunities.
Partner with Sales: Collaborate closely with Account Executives to flag growth potential and technical risks—handing off commercial execution, pricing, and contract negotiations to the AE.
Orchestration & Technical Acumen/Expertise
Resource Orchestration: Serve as the primary point of alignment, pulling in Professional Services for complex implementations, Support for technical troubleshooting, or Field CTOs for deep architectural guidance.
Domain Fluency: Maintain a solid, working acumen/expertise around DevOps, CI/CD, cloud technologies, and modern development practices (e.g., AI/agentic coding) to speak intelligently with engineering leaders without answering hands-on code/configuration queries.

Key Working Relationships:

External Constituents (The Client)

The CSM maps and nurtures relationships across all tiers of the client organization:

Executive Sponsors & Economic Buyers: VPs of Engineering, CIOs, Heads of Infrastructure/Platform—to align on business drivers, demonstrate ROI during EBRs, and secure executive sponsorship.
Internal Champions: Engineering Directors, DevOps Leads, and Platform Managers—to drive adoption roadmaps, track project execution, and advocate for platform expansion.
Operational Teams & Practitioners: Lead Architects, SRE Leads, and CI/CD Admins—to monitor usage trends, sentiment, and systemic operational blockers (while redirecting tactical execution/support queries to appropriate CB channels).

Internal Constituents (CloudBees)

The CSM acts as the central hub connecting internal teams to deliver a unified customer experience:

Account Executive (AE): Partner on account strategy; feed qualified expansion, service, and upsell opportunities to the AE, while maintaining a unified front on account health.
Professional Services (PS Closers & PS Advisors): Engage PS Closers/Engagement Managers when custom delivery or paid advisory is needed; collaborate with PS Advisors during onboarding and implementation projects.
Technical Support: Monitor escalation trends and high-priority tickets; act as an internal advocate to ensure critical support issues are prioritized without acting as a ticket wrangler.
Field CTOs / Solutions Architects: Pull in senior technical leadership for strategic architecture conversations, roadmap briefings, and complex technical validation.
Product Management & Engineering: Voice customer enhancement requests, operational pain points, and strategic feedback to influence product roadmaps.

Commercial Boundaries:

The CSM drives retention and account growth through strategic alignment but does not own:

Contract renewals or amendments
Commercial negotiations, pricing, or quoting
Procurement and legal execution

These activities are owned by the Account Executive.

Skills & Experience:

Required

5+ years in Customer Success, Client Account Management, or Strategic Account Management in enterprise SaaS or IT consulting (e.g., Accenture, Wipro, TCS, IBM Global Services model).
Proven track record of managing enterprise accounts, conducting EBRs, and driving adoption programs.
High Technical Aptitude: Ability to converse fluently with Engineering Leaders, DevOps Managers, and Enterprise Architects on software delivery challenges without being a hands-on developer.
Project Management: Strong project management, strategic thinking, and executive presentation skills.
Organizational Change Management: Driving bottom-up developer adoption strategies to help enterprise teams overcome workflow inertia.
Customer Advocacy: Converting mature enterprise champions into reference accounts, public case studies, and Customer Advisory Board (CAB) participants.
Customer Obsessed — You treat customer problems as your own and build relationships with the people behind the logo, not just the account. You can point to decisions you changed because of what a customer told you.
High Agency — You own problems beyond your job description and move without waiting to be asked. When the path isn't defined, you make the call and bring people with you rather than working around them.
Truth Seeking — You hold a strong point of view and update it when the data says otherwise. You argue for the best answer regardless of who's in the room, and once a decision is made, you commit to it fully.
Hard Work — You own the end result, not just your slice of it, and you go beyond what's expected to get there. You work smart as well as hard, and you find real reward in building something demanding alongside people who do the same.
Ship Excellence — You hold a painfully high quality bar and keep raising it, while shipping with urgency instead of waiting for perfect. Every iteration is something you learn from.
Direct Feedback — You give honest, constructive feedback regardless of seniority or tenure, and you actively ask for it in return. You deliver it with enough care that people want to hear it from you.

Preferred

Understanding of modern SDLC, DevOps culture, CI/CD, and enterprise cloud deployments.
Experience working alongside Professional Services and Technical Support teams to deliver complex customer outcomes.

Success Measures:

Time-to-Value & Onboarding Completion
Gross & Net Retention Support (via technical adoption and account health)
Expansion Pipeline Created (leads handed off to Sales/PS)
Customer Health Score & CSAT
Execution of Account Success Plans & EBRs

Upside when we win. Base salary is the floor. Our Variable MBO Compensation plan rewards for the goals you deliver and the growth we drive together.
A global, collaborative team that lives by our values: Customer Obsessed, High Agency, Truth Seeking, Hard Work, Ship Excellence, Direct Feedback.
People who sweat the craft. A team that takes its work seriously and invests in each other's growth.

£60,000 to £70,000 base + 10% bonus and comprehensive benefits
Location:
Old Street 2 days per week, 3 days from home.

Why this role?

Take ownership of complex customer projects for large organisations in the UK and internationally.
Join a successful, growing B2B technology business where your work has real visibility and impact.
Combine project leadership, customer consulting and problem-solving in a role with plenty of autonomy.
Work closely with senior customer stakeholders from initial handover through to successful launch.

About our client

Our client is an established B2B fintech providing software to large organisations around the world.

Following continued growth, they are expanding their professional services team to support an increasing number of enterprise customers.

The business has built a collaborative, high-trust culture where people are given genuine ownership of their work. It offers the pace and autonomy of a scale-up, alongside the stability of an established and successful software business.

As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will take ownership of customer implementation projects from the point a new client signs through to successful launch.

You’ll become the main point of contact during this process, bringing together customer teams and internal specialists to keep projects moving and ensure everything is delivered successfully.
It’s a varied role. One day you might be running a customer workshop, the next resolving an implementation challenge, managing competing priorities or helping senior stakeholders understand what needs to happen next.

You won’t need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable working with technology and discussing requirements with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What you will be doing

Manage multiple enterprise customer projects from kick-off through to launch.
Own project plans, milestones, dependencies and customer communication.
Run discovery sessions, workshops and regular project meetings.
Coordinate customer teams and internal specialists to keep projects on track.
Identify potential problems early and take ownership of resolving them.
Help customers understand requirements and translate complex information into clear next steps.
Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders throughout the implementation process.
Ensure customers have a smooth transition into using the platform successfully.
Contribute to improving delivery processes as the professional services function continues to grow.

What you will need to succeed

Experience working in SaaS professional services or implementation for a fintech company.
A track record of delivering complex projects for larger or enterprise customers.
Confidence managing several customer projects at the same time.
Comfortable working with technical teams and understanding how different software systems and data processes fit together.
Excellent communication skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders.
A practical, proactive approach to solving problems.
Comfortable working in a growing technology business where processes are still evolving.

You’ll suit this role if you enjoy taking ownership, working directly with customers and being the person responsible for getting complex projects over the line.

My client is a well-established, multi-disciplinary property and design group. It brings together specialists in architecture, engineering, interior design, surveying and land sourcing under one roof, so clients get joined-up support from the first site appraisal through to completion.

Planning is central to almost everything the group delivers. It now wants to appoint a Head of Planning to lead planning across all in-house projects. Working directly with the Managing Director, you'll also help build a planning consultancy service for external clients.

This is a rare chance to own the planning function from day one. You'll shape how it works, build its reputation and grow it into a standalone revenue-generating service.

The role

Act as the in-house planning lead across a varied portfolio, including residential, barn conversions, listed buildings and heritage, commercial, mixed-use and masterplanning.
Give strategic planning advice from early feasibility and land appraisal through to submission, determination and discharge of conditions.
Prepare and manage planning applications, appeals, pre-application submissions and supporting statements.
Work closely with in-house architects, engineers and designers so planning strategy shapes design from the start.
Build strong relationships with local planning authorities, statutory consultees and other stakeholders across Kent and the South East.
Work with the MD to set up the external planning consultancy, including the service offering, fee structures, positioning and growth plans.
Lead business development and work winning, including identifying opportunities, writing fee proposals and bids, and turning leads into instructions.
Develop and look after a client base of landowners, developers, self-builders, promoters and commercial clients.
Represent the business at networking events and industry forums, and through referral partners.
As the service grows, build and lead a planning team.

About you

A chartered town planner (MRTPI), with substantial post-qualification experience.
Currently working in, or with a strong background in, private-sector planning consultancy.
Experienced in running a varied, multi-project caseload and moving between scales and project types with confidence.
A proven record of winning work and developing clients. You're comfortable generating fees, not just delivering them.
Commercially minded, with an entrepreneurial streak and the drive to build something rather than simply step into it.
Strong knowledge of national and local planning policy, with heritage and rural or Green Belt experience a real advantage.
Knowledge of the Kent and wider South East planning landscape and local authorities would be a significant plus.
A confident communicator who earns credibility quickly with clients, design teams and planning officers.

What's on offer

A salary of £60,000 to £80,000 depending on experience, plus a benefits package.
Flexible working.
A senior, high-visibility role working directly with the MD.
The chance to build and lead a new consultancy offering, with real influence over its direction and growth.
A collaborative, multi-disciplinary setting where planning sits at the heart of every project.
Long-term career progression as the planning service grows.

About Clearwater Analytics

Clearwater Analytics® is a global SaaS solution for automated investment data aggregation, reconciliation, accounting, and reporting. Clearwater helps thousands of organisations make the most of investment portfolio data with cloud-native software and client-centric servicing. Every day, investment professionals worldwide trust Clearwater to deliver timely, validated investment data and in-depth reporting.

Job Description

We are looking for a Solutions Consultant to join our growing EMEA Asset Owner team in London - corporate pension schemes, local government pension funds (LGPS), sovereign wealth funds, and insurers, front to back office. In this client-facing, pre-sales role you will be central to how Clearwater wins and onboards complex asset management mandates — owning the technical and written deliverables that move opportunities through the sales cycle. 

You will partner with prospective clients to uncover the pain points in their current operating model and demonstrate, clearly and credibly, how the Clearwater solution solves those problems and adds measurable value. Alongside this you will build and refine the sales resources, documentation and standards the wider EMEA team relies on, continually looking for ways to strengthen our proposition. 

The ideal candidate is a creative, self-starting problem-solver who earns the trust of internal and external stakeholders alike, combining strong technical fluency with the commercial instinct to turn complex requirements into compelling solutions.

Responsibilities

Work with prospective clients to understand their current infrastructure, business requirements and operational challenges, and articulate how Clearwater's solution enhances their operating model. 

Lead the pre-sales workstream on complex software sales, from discovery through to solution design and handover. 
Develop deep, demonstrable expertise across Clearwater's products and the value they deliver. 
Communicate Clearwater's core value proposition persuasively, through written documentation, demonstrations and live presentations. 
Own the completion, organisation and coordination of prospect RFPs and DDQs, ensuring high-quality, accurate and timely responses. 
Conduct the research and preparation that underpins high-impact sales meetings and demos. 
Coordinate resources across Clearwater to support sales efforts and a smooth transition of new clients to our Global Delivery team. 
Solve complex, abstract problems and develop creative solutions to non-standard client requirements. 

Required Skills:

Proven record of exceeding goals/quotas. 
Relevant experience in Asset Management, Asset Owner, Insurance, Investment Management, FinTech, Investment Accounting, or Investment Operations. 
Commitment to agility, continuous learning, improvement, and operational excellence. 
Strong data analysis skills. 
Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.  
Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.  
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.  
Strong organizational and interpersonal skills. 
Exceptional problem-solving abilities.   

Requirements:

Relevant experience in investment operations, investment management, insurance or investment accounting. 
A clear understanding of the challenges facing the industry, particularly around reporting, data management and accounting. 
Familiarity with the needs of the different personas within an asset owner, from front office to operations, finance and technology and a proficient understanding of the Asset Owner market in UK and Europe.
Good knowledge of financial services and fixed income securities; a professional qualification such as the CFA is preferable. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and articulate complex propositions clearly. 
Strong organisational, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. 
Strong technical skills, including Excel and the ability to quickly become proficient in in-house software solutions. 
A commitment to agility, continuous learning and operational excellence, combined with competitiveness, curiosity, creativity and drive. 
Fluent in business English, additional languages preferable

new_jobs.description:
Frontify is the brand platform behind some of the world's leading organizations, including Microsoft, Telefónica, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Kia. We help every team bring brands to life — with governance in one place, seamless workflows across the tools people already use, and a foundation that's ready for AI.

We're driven by collaboration, curiosity, and the belief that great work can happen anywhere. What began in St. Gallen has grown to London, New York, and beyond. Wherever you join us, you'll take ownership from day one, shape work that reaches global brands, and help redefine how brands work in the age of AI.

What You'll Shape

You’ll be the ultimate product expert: The go-to person for detailed instructions and guidance on what is (and what isn’t) possible with Frontify. Not only do you know how to position Frontify for various use cases when helping our commercial teams during a pitch, but you’ll also find creative workarounds and alternative ways of using our platform in order to improve the value a customer gets out of Frontify, and you will add valuable insights for our product strategy based on customer interactions. To best support our commercial teams, you’ll also get to know the tools our customers use most and advise on how to use Frontify with these tools through integrations, plugins, or separately. These tools include Figma, InDesign, CMSs and n8n. You’re curious to learn how our customers use items like Frontify’s API and SDK to improve their Frontify experience, even if you haven’t worked with these before.

As the centralized repository for technical consulting, you’ll collaborate with our Sales and Customer Success teams to successfully convert opportunities and grow accounts over time. You’ll also build a bridge to Product Marketing and Product Management teams to generate scalable materials and trainings that will help the company’s commercial success.

What You'll Do

You'll become the go-to expert on Frontify, advising internal teams on platform capabilities, best practices, and creative solutions for a wide range of customer use cases.
You'll partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to deliver technical consultations, support customer evaluations, and help convert opportunities into long-term customer partnerships.
You'll position Frontify's capabilities through tailored demonstrations and solution design, finding innovative ways to maximize customer value.
You'll advise customers and internal teams on integrating Frontify with tools such as Figma, Adobe InDesign, CMS platforms, automation tools, and other technologies.
You'll deepen your expertise in Frontify's APIs, SDK, and extensibility capabilities to help customers solve complex technical challenges.
You'll capture customer feedback and technical insights to influence product strategy and help shape future platform development.
You'll collaborate with Product Marketing and Product Management to create scalable enablement content, technical documentation, and training materials for commercial teams.
You'll continuously explore new technologies, customer workflows, and industry trends to strengthen Frontify's technical consulting capabilities.
Comfortable with a hybrid work model, spending 1-2 days per week in our St. Gallen or London office.

What You Bring

You have 4+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role, ideally in SaaS.
You combine strong technical curiosity with a commercial mindset and enjoy helping customers solve complex business challenges.
You're quick to master new products and technical concepts, and you thrive on becoming the trusted expert others turn to for guidance.
You're familiar with design, automation, or collaboration tools such as Figma, Adobe InDesign, Make.com, or n8n. Experience with APIs or SDKs is a plus.
You balance strategic thinking with attention to detail, always keeping the broader business impact in mind.

CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.

Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.

CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.

Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.

Requirements

Position Summary:

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is the strategic quarterback for an assigned portfolio of enterprise accounts, responsible for driving customers from initial deployment to long-term value realization. Acting as a trusted partner—akin to a Client Account Manager in IT consulting—the CSM builds deep relationships across customer leadership, manages execution roadmaps, and ensures the customer achieves measurable business outcomes using the CloudBees platform.

While possessing high technical aptitude and fluency in modern DevOps, CI/CD, and agentic coding concepts, the CSM is not a hands-on technical implementer. Instead, the CSM orchestrates internal resources (Support, Professional Services, Field CTOs) to solve technical challenges while keeping their focus on platform adoption, customer health, and uncovering strategic expansion opportunities.

Note: This role will be in Hybrid in London, and the scope of the role will cover the EMEA territory.

Value Realization & Account Leadership (The Quarterback)
Drive Business Outcomes: Partner with key stakeholders to define technical success, build actionable adoption roadmaps, and track customer progress toward clear ROI.

Strategic Discovery & Expansion Pipeline
Identify Opportunities: Deeply understand customer workflows to uncover unaddressed needs, expansion pathways, and professional services opportunities.
Partner with Sales: Collaborate closely with Account Executives to flag growth potential and technical risks—handing off commercial execution, pricing, and contract negotiations to the AE.

Resource Orchestration: Serve as the primary point of alignment, pulling in Professional Services for complex implementations, Support for technical troubleshooting, or Field CTOs for deep architectural guidance.

Operational Teams & Practitioners: Lead Architects, SRE Leads, and CI/CD Admins—to monitor usage trends, sentiment, and systemic operational blockers (while redirecting tactical execution/support queries to appropriate CB channels).

Contract renewals or amendments
Commercial negotiations, pricing, or quoting
Procurement and legal execution

5+ years in Customer Success, Client Account Management, or Strategic Account Management in enterprise SaaS or IT consulting (e.g., Accenture, Wipro, TCS, IBM Global Services model).

Drive customer adoption of Workiva solutions
Ensure continuous ROI to your customers
Consult on best practices, workflows, and management business reviews
Develop multi-purpose relationships throughout customer organizations
Identify risks within named accounts & take appropriate actions to manage and/or escalate to an efficient resolution
Ensure all customers are continuously working toward key milestones of the Customer Journey using customer-facing Success Plans
Advocate for customers internally by providing continuous feedback to Workiva’s Sales, Services, Marketing, Product, & Engineering teams
Work with Sales to understand the details of upcoming renewals
Teach customers how to use the Workiva Platform
Use customer management tools to track customer communication, issues, and metrics

Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of experience and education in a related field; an advanced degree may be considered in lieu of professional experience

Experience supporting a SaaS application preferred

Ability to understand complex problems and explain the source of those problems simply
Strong communication and presentation skills with a high level of comfort in delivering consultative recommendations
Self-starter with strong time management and prioritization skills

Willingness to travel up to 10% for team and corporate meetings, fostering relationships and representing company interests
Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, as we embrace flexible work arrangements

Serves as the primary post-sale point of contact for clients/customers. Uses in-depth knowledge of client industry and/or business processes, deep knowledge of the product being sold and technical expertise to drive and increase adoption and utilization of company products. May handle escalations and coordinate across functional areas of the company, including Marketing, Sales, Professional Services, Engineering, Finance, Training, and/or Support. May or may not be on a sales incentive plan that is based on individual and/or team sales results (e.g., revenue, bookings, unit sales). This is an individual contributor role.

Scope

Contributes to small team by taking ownership to deliver assigned activities

Problem Solving

Works on minimally ambiguous problems where solutions are often readily available
Situations typically require an evaluative review of a variety of factors to understand problems
Applies company policies, business understanding and acquired techniques to complete day-to-day assignments

Discretion and Impact

Minimally impacts quality of own work and the work of others on team
Exercises judgment, within defined procedures; sometimes adapts practices in order to apply appropriate action

May interact with high-level individual contributors and managers across multiple areas
Builds productive internal working relationships that require regular interaction across similar areas

Autonomy

Based on clearly defined objectives, receives general instructions on routine work, detailed guidance on new assignments; begins to independently prioritize work
May provide broad guidance to individuals in process-oriented roles

Knowledge

Working knowledge and practical understanding of fundamental Workiva technical standards and methods
Applying professional principles, techniques, and procedures in own area of discipline; begins to take ownership of assigned activities

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.
